description.narrative: The development objectives are to strengthen participatory local governance, support climate-reslient and quality local Infrastructure, and increase livelihood opportunities for women.

The proposed Additional Financing (AF) to the National Community Initiatives Project (NCIP) builds on a well-established community-driven delivery platform operating across 40 Aiyl Aimaks (AAs) in all seven oblasts of the Kyrgyz Republic. The AF responds to unmet demand for socio-economic infrastructure and economic opportunities, while advancing the Government's regional economic and territorial reform agenda for balanced and inclusive local development.The AF expands NCIP's geographic coverage to an additional 21 AAs, replicating the parent project's participatory planning approach, and extends livelihoods and skills support to 24 AA communities currently without access to economic development interventions, with a focus on women and youth. It also strengthens the strategic coherence of the program by integrating infrastructure, economic inclusion, jobs, gender, care economy, human capital, and climate resilience within a single community-level platform.Together, these investments will scale up inclusive, climate-resilient local development, broaden labor market activation and income generation opportunities, and institutionalize community-led approaches within local self-government structures across the Kyrgyz Republic.
